title: iRacing GR86 Oulton Park International Guide 1:48.4 Fixed Toyota GR86 Oulton Park Int Track Guide

corners.line: cut the corner back on the gas exit wide
corners.exit: keep the right hand tires on the track

corners.mistakes: left hand tires would have been over that rumble strip

corners.exit: back on the gas soon as we can straighten our wheel

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: brakes to about 8% down to second gear
corners.line: get nice and tight to that set of walls
corners.exit: back on the gas lightly on the brakes back on the gas in second give yourself room on the left hand side little lift back on the gas and then change it to third as we exit

corners.label: T15
corners.braking: brakes to about 45% down to third gear
corners.line: try and get your right-hand tires over that rumble strip
cut the corner without hitting the hilly bit
corners.exit: exit wide, can touch grass on off track

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: brake in a straight line towards the outside of turn five
corners.line: start picking on the gas where I am now

corners.braking: get on the brakes at the apex, roll on to about 75%
corners.line: start my turn in at the furthest left part of that white line
corners.exit: back on the gas once I'm right alongside this tire wall
corners.mistakes: to go fast around here, you do have to get nice and tight

corners.braking: Midway between 100 and 50, full brake, trail off at apex
corners.line: Turn left to give room for Knickerbrook

corners.braking: At green hatched part, 45% trail off
corners.exit: Keep car from understeering too far out

corners.label: T16
corners.braking: Halfway between right side and marshal's hut (22)

corners.line: Get right-hand tires over the rumble strip onto the grassy bit

general_tips: keep the right hand tires on the track these days
